notes.title: Quiz Quest Lauch Livestream
notes.notes: [p]Creator of Quiz Quest, Joe Newton, invits you to play along to celebrate the launch!![/p]

notes.title: Quiz Quest Discord server now live!
notes.notes:
The official Quiz Quest Discord server is now live! Join our community to access chats, weekly competitions and exclusive Alpha playtesting! LINK: [url=https://discord.gg/QrGRQkzp]discord/quiz-quest[/url] 
	We are hoping to launch our closed Alpha this November and our Discord server will be the only place where you can sign up. Don’t miss out!

notes.title: Quiz Quest Demo Update
notes.notes:
The Quiz Quest Demo has been updated with some exciting new features including: playable weapons, a Settings screen and improved UI artwork and animation.

Test your knowledge (and your shiny new weapons) against notorious highwayman Robin Yewblind!

(WARNING: some reconnection issues may still occur! Please bear with us!!)

notes.title: Devlog Post #1
notes.notes:
I thought it was about time I started a devlog to keep you all updated about the development of 'Quiz Quest'. I posted it last week but forgot to announce it on here, so here it is now! Better late than never! The second post will be later this week and then it will be weekly from there. Feel free to comment and ask any questions you like. Cheers! Enjoy!

notes.title: New art has arrived for the demo!!
notes.notes: Robin Yewblind and Quizimojo have recently enjoyed makeovers. See their beauty for yourselves!! (and play the latest demo)

notes.title: Quiz Quest - Meet the developers
notes.notes: As part of Steam Next Fest 2023, we are streaming the demo of Quiz Quest, a choose-your-own-adventure co-op quiz party game. Join the developers, take part in demo playtesting and ask us questions!

notes.title: DEMO NOW AVALIBLE!
notes.notes: The demo, featuring an ambush on a lonely forest road is now available. Grab a friend (or 5) and give it a go!
